title: Industries that Businesses and Workforce should Pivot to Post-COVID-19
what_it_is: Industries that Businesses and Workforce should Pivot to Post-COVID-19

sections.label: Post-COVID-19 industry assessment question
sections.summary: A question asks the Minister for Trade and Industry which industries the business community and workforce should pivot to post-COVID-19.

sentences.text: The following question stood in the name of  Mr Seah Kian Peng –  12 To ask the Minister for Trade and Industry what is the assessment of industries in the post-COVID-19 era, specifically which are those that the business community and workforce should pivot to and position themselves going forward.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: It will change the global economy and social norms in far more significant ways than past crises.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: We will likely remain in a COVID-19 environment for some time; and even when the pandemic recedes, life would not return to what it used to be.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Trade flows will be affected by the reconfiguration of supply chains.

sections.label: Singapore's open economy response
sections.summary: As a small and open economy, Singapore's response cannot be to turn inward.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: As a small and open economy, Singapore’s response cannot be to turn inward.

sections.label: Changing consumption and Asian middle class
sections.summary: Changing consumption preferences and a rising middle class in Asia will drive new demand.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: First, changing consumption preferences, coupled with a rising middle class in Asia, will drive new demand.

sections.label: Reconfigured global supply chains
sections.summary: Global supply chains will be reconfigured as businesses seek to balance efficiency and resilience.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Second, global supply chains will be reconfigured as businesses seek to balance efficiency and resilience.

sections.label: Greater digital economy salience
sections.summary: The digital economy will take on greater salience and Singapore must be prepared to seize its opportunities.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Third, the digital economy will take on greater salience than before and we must be prepared to seize the opportunities it brings.

sections.label: Businesses pivot to digital economy
sections.summary: Businesses will need to pivot towards the digital economy, with Government support for transformation and worker training.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry)
sentences.text: Businesses will need to pivot towards the digital economy, and the Government will continue to extend strong support to help our enterprises to transform their business models and to train our workers in new skills to prepare them for this digital economy.
